## How I tested it

- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `go test ./...` (or the packages I changed)
- [ ] `node --test web/tests/*.check.mjs`
- [ ] `node --test test/` (if I changed `src/` or `server.js`)

## Checklist

- [ ] New screen states have a TV fixture or phone scene, and a check in `web/tests`
- [ ] Fixtures were regenerated with the scripts, not edited by hand
- [ ] `docs/` is updated if what goes over the wire or the rules changed
- [ ] No tests were skipped, loosened or deleted to make them pass
- [ ] Files use LF line endings
